bounded_slice.tested_scope: Exact pinned lbx154/Argus commit 2894b434affaff3a28c1fbbcd5c39f2e7a832236, limited only to argus_skill/webapi/manager_bridge.py and only the manager_message path reached from the previously tested routes/manager.py surface. observations: manager_message calls _classify_operator_turn and assigns classify.root_task_id to local root_task_id.
The same local root_task_id is then passed into _run_triage_and_fallbacks and, if the path continues to TEAM dispatch, into _dispatch_team_mission.
The exact pinned manager_bridge.py surface contains no occurrence or direct invocation of manager_bounded_handoff.
The exact pinned manager_bridge.py surface contains no name_session argument or name_session=true setting.

This selected surface therefore demonstrates propagation of a root_task_id value across the manager_message path, but it does not establish that the value is generated and non-null at the eventual bounded-handoff invocation, nor that any bounded-handoff invocation uses name_session=true.
Because both downstream helper implementations live in manager_dispatch.py, proving or disproving the required conjunction would require a second production surface and is intentionally deferred.
bounded_slice.acceptance_effect: Exact-surface evidence only. The pinned manager_bridge manager_message path propagates classify.root_task_id into downstream manager_dispatch helpers, but manager_bridge.py itself neither invokes manager_bounded_handoff nor sets name_session=true, and it does not prove a generated non-null root_task_id reaches the same bounded-handoff invocation. The Phase-1 child remains unresolved.
